description: Make two URLs that show a plan in the browser with nothing to install, for handing to a person. `playground` opens it in the hosted editor, rendered; `embed` draws it alone, for an iframe. The plan travels inside the URL, after the `#`, so it is never sent to a server and the URL carries nothing else. A plan that does not compile still gets links, and the page shows its diagnostics; `ok` says whether it compiles, and `errors` counts the errors when it does not. `bytes` is the size of the compressed plan in the URL.
name: link
title: Share link to the rendered plan
